blocks.heading: Medical Coding Salary After BSc Nursing
rows: Hold CPC-A when you apply, and compare employers and cities before you accept.
Hit the accuracy and chart targets without a mentor checking every chart.
Pick one chart type, such as surgery, radiology or doctor-visit (E/M) coding, and get good at it.
Rs 0.5-12 lakh (10 salaries, too scattered to trust)
Two logged years let you drop the A from CPC-A. Ask about review and audit work.
Build a record of accurate audits, and be ready to defend a code to an auditor.

blocks.heading: Documentation Review and Audit
rows: Any graduate with a coding certification. A nurse can skip the anatomy and terminology study.
Ask for the accuracy target and the number of charts per day before you accept.
Coders with logged experience and a strong accuracy record.
Ask what share of the work is checking other people's codes, not coding new charts.
In ACDIS's 2023 survey, 74% of 781 respondents held an RN credential, which is a US licence. One UnitedHealth Group listing in Chennai asks for an MBBS degree.
Read each listing for the exact degree. A BSc nursing degree may not qualify you directly.

items.text: You read clinical charts every day, so terms like "bilateral", "post-op" and "comorbidity" cost you no study time.
You can spot when a note does not support a code, which is the core of audit and documentation review.
AAPC asks new CPC students to cover anatomy, pathophysiology and terminology unless they already know them.
